admit_map.obligation: Reject length != source real-state count or any target index >= target real-state count; in ResourceExtension require injective map by value, in Exact permit many-to-one maps. All invalid maps have InvalidMap. Borrow only; no role swapping, reconstruction or implicit surjectivity. Private source/target admission guarantees nonempty carriers and closed transitions.

admit_encoding.obligation: Require exactly one target-event word per source input, including empty macro words if provided. Reject every out-of-target-alphabet symbol even after an earlier unavailable step. Both transition tables have a first row by private nonempty admission. InvalidEncoding precedes work admission. Empty alphabets and empty encoding tables are valid together.

admit_budget.obligation: Compute checked width=1+sum over macros(length+1), then checked width*states. Any overflow or strictly cost>max_cells returns WorkLimit, exact boundary passes. states=0 is permitted by this private scalar helper but unreachable through public admitted nonempty source/map. Budget is a cell estimate, not bytes/elapsed-time/allocator admission.

compare_step.signature:
fn compare_step(
    expected: Option<usize>,
    actual: Option<usize>,
    mode: SimulationMode,
    coordinate: (usize, usize),
    added: &mut Vec<(usize, usize)>,
) -> Option<SimulationDecision>
compare_step.obligation: If expected None, actual Some and mode ResourceExtension, append the original (state,input) coordinate exactly once and continue. Otherwise unequal Options return StepMismatch preserving both exact values and coordinate; equal Options continue. Both unavailable is equal but never an added availability. Exact mode never permits added availability; extension may not drop or alter an old defined mapped target. Mutates only caller-owned provisional output vector.

check_state.signature:
fn check_state(
    source: &PartialDynamics,
    target: &PartialDynamics,
    map: &[usize],
    words: &[Vec<usize>],
    mode: SimulationMode,
    state: usize,
    added: &mut Vec<(usize, usize)>,
) -> Result<Option<SimulationDecision>, SimulationError>
check_state.obligation: Precondition: state < admitted map length = source state count, valid target map, one fully typed word per source input. Check raw report equality before any step in this state. For each macro in input order compare mapped source target (or None) against full target.run at mapped state. compare_step appends extension additions or returns first mismatch. Provider errors map to InvalidEncoding defensively; with these admitted tables/full alphabet checks that branch is not publicly reachable. No state data changes.

check_simulation.signature:
pub fn check_simulation(
    source: &PartialDynamics,
    target: &PartialDynamics,
    map: &[usize],
    words: &[Vec<usize>],
    mode: SimulationMode,
    max_cells: usize,
) -> Result<SimulationDecision, SimulationError>
check_simulation.obligation: Ordered phase composition map->encoding->checked budget, then states in ascending source index. Stop at first report/step mismatch and return it as an Ok decision, discarding provisional additions from earlier coordinates. Only when every report/step is compatible return Checked with all and only added availability coordinates in source-state/input order. Exact defines partial-step simulation with report preservation, hence every encoded word; extension requires injective map and preserves every old defined step, while additions are explicit.

verify_simulation.signature:
pub fn verify_simulation(
    source: &PartialDynamics,
    target: &PartialDynamics,
    map: &[usize],
    words: &[Vec<usize>],
    mode: SimulationMode,
    max_cells: usize,
    c: &SimulationDecision,
) -> Result<(), SimulationError>
verify_simulation.obligation: Recompute with all expected source/target/map/encoding/mode/budget arguments, propagate typed admission/resource refusals first, then compare entire canonical SimulationDecision structurally. Ok(()) may verify a correct ReportMismatch or StepMismatch diagnostic; it does not mean a successful simulation. Only a Checked decision certifies compatible admitted input. Any coordinate, payload, ordering or added-list difference is CertificateMismatch.

provider_refinement: PartialDynamics private new rejects empty reports, transition-row count/width mismatch and out-of-range Some targets; getters borrow immutable data and no public mutator/default/deserializer bypass exists. Source/target indices and macro alphabet are validated before scans. run validates start and the WHOLE word alphabet, then Option-folds each transition; None remains None, empty word returns input state. All source target lookups map through a total admitted map. No quotient or distinction search is used here, so no Moore refinement theorem is needed to establish these call paths. Readouts are exact primitive usize equality, MAX valid; a shared semantic interpretation is a caller premise rather than a dictionary admitted here.

phase_preservation.argument: Former guard blocks become admit_map/admit_encoding/admit_budget without predicate/error/order changes. Former per-state report and per-input transition block becomes check_state/compare_step; provisional added vector remains local, first mismatch exits and drops it. Source-state indices iterate 0..map.len(), equivalent to enumerating admitted map. No callback or data mutation moved across phases.

data_trait_derive_macro_review: Two concrete copyable mode tags, four refusal tags and three public decision variants. Decisions remain untrusted raw data; constructors do not create an immutable certified architecture. Standard Debug/Clone/PartialEq/Eq/Copy over primitive integer/Option/Vec/enum fields. No unsafe, floats, numeric coercion, external effect or user callback. Vec/Option helper allocation and private indexing reviewed with admitted state invariants.
cost_review: Let n be source real states, k source input count, W=sum macro lengths, and r added availability coordinates. Map admission costs O(n) plus O(n log(n+1)) comparisons/O(n) temporary references only in ResourceExtension for injection. Exact avoids building that set. Membership uses integer referent values, not pointer addresses.

Encoding admission and checked width cost O(k+W); no copy of any word or dynamics table. Each of n state checks does one report comparison and k macro executions; target.run scans each word alphabet then Option-folds it, O(length) including unavailable suffix validation. Total O(n*(1+k+W)) scalar/index operations plus admission, with no product-state/quotient search. No mapping/word cloning, scratch tuple Strings or per-step BTreeSet allocation.

Only the required output added vector allocates during state/input scans, with r<=n*k and amortized append. A mismatch is fixed-size data and discards provisional additions; helpers return Options/Results by value without heap work. Work estimate n*(1+sum(length+1)) is checked, but omits allocator/tree overhead and does not certify bytes/time. Input storage already supplied by caller is outside it.

verify_simulation reconstructs the entire expected decision, then structural equality of enum payloads/added order, intentionally paying the same cost. It is not a trust shortcut or alternate-producer proof. Derived Clone/Debug/Eq cost the stored/visited output structure; helper compare_step never clones input data.

Fresh source AST covers all seven bodies, max CCN7,cognitive6,nesting2, no opaque function macros. Previous main CCN17/cognitive21/nesting3 is retained with original source/score; meaningful phase separation discharges that A ceiling. No MIR, allocator-totality or benchmark claim.
consumer_review: Only lib.rs/mod.rs module declarations expose this subject; no external symbol consumer in local Rust source search. No completed assessment context refers to this provider; no provider refresh is needed. Native controls compile real local PartialDynamics in actual category package; external similarly named omega packages are outside scope.

Public signatures, data shapes/derives and verify_simulation body are unchanged. check_simulation phases and first failure order match parent; extracted private helpers have explicit admitted-map/index preconditions. No capability promotion from refactor: L3 bounded-domain simulation/typed decision replay.

Extensional allowed-pair truth table, direct word execution and independently sorted diagnostic events. Separate two-event coordinate order/empty alphabet/shape/range/precedence/overflow checks. Bounded verification is not exhaustive for larger machines.
